in_text_mentions: A transthoracic echocardiogram (TTE) revealed left ventricular (LV) hyperkinesia with an ejection fraction of 72% (Figure 4A). Doppler echocardiographic measurements disclosed the following values: early-to-late mitral peak flow velocity ratio of 1:1 (Figure 4B), peak tricuspid regurgitation velocity of 3.0 m/second (Figure 4C), and LV outflow tract velocity time integral of 25.4 cm (Figure 4D). These TTE findings suggested a high CO state. Accordingly, serum thiamine was additionally measured, and right-sided cardiac catheterization was planned.
